entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need to make a return. Order number is 8-4-Charlie-5-1.
Okay, let me just pull that up for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Flow jersey. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the wrong size. It's just way too tight across the chest. Can I return it, yes or no?
I understand. And just to confirm, it's a preference on the fit, not a technical fault with the jersey itself?
Yes, that's right. I just need to send it back.

Absolutely. I see here it was delivered 59 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. I've just approved that for you. I can email you the return label right now. Would you prefer a refund, or did you want to do an exchange for a larger size?
Just the refund is fine. So the label is on its way?

Yes, it should be in your inbox in the next two minutes. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived the standard return processing fee and added a complimentary expedited shipping credit to your account for your next order.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
